title: Sissy Squat
summary: A knee-dominant squat where you lean back as your knees go forward, stretching the quads including the rectus femoris.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.

setup.text: Hold a support with one hand and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lean back as you bend your knees forward and down, keeping your hips straight.
Go as low as you can control, then push back up.

form_cues.cue: Lean back as the knees move forward
Rise back up with the quads
Keep a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.

mistakes.text: Bending at the hips into a regular squat.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Peak-contraction focus, Better isolation.
